units.title: Introduction to Quality and Process Control
topics: Concepts of Quality Control (QC) and Quality Assurance (QA) in textile wet processing
Flowcharts of process control checkpoints from grey fabric inspection to finished goods
Role of online vs. offline testing
Introduction to standard testing bodies (ISO
AATCC
ASTM)

units.title: Process Control & Evaluation of Preparatory Processes
topics: Singeing & Desizing: Control of flame intensity and fabric speed
Evaluation of desizing efficiency using the Tegewa scale
Scouring: Control of alkali concentration
time, and temperature in continuous scouring (J-Box)
Evaluation of absorbency (drop test
wicking test) and residual wax content
Bleaching: Control of pH, stabilizer concentration, and temperature in H2O2 bleaching
Assessment of Whiteness/Yellowness index and chemical degradation (fluidity/copper number test)
Mercerization: Control of caustic soda strength
tension, and temperature
Evaluation of mercerization efficiency via Barium Activity Number (BAN)

units.title: Color Quality Control and Dyeing Diagnostics
topics: Instrumental Color Evaluation: Introduction to Spectrophotometers
CIE Lab color space, and total color difference Delta- E pass/fail concepts
Introduction to Computer Color Matching (CCM) and K/S curves
Dyeing Process Control: Control of dye liquor ratio
exhausting agents (salts)
fixing agents (alkalis)
temperature profiles, and machine parameters (Jigger
Winch
Padding Mangle)
Fault Analysis: Identification
root causes, and corrective measures for common dyeing faults (un-levelness
listing
ending
barre effects)

units.title: Evaluation of Printing and Functional Finishes
topics: Printing Quality: Control of print paste viscosity
squeegee pressure, and curing/steaming parameters
Evaluation of sharpness
registration defects, and paste penetration
Testing of Functional Finishes: Standard evaluation methods for the finishing
Crease recovery angle (CRA) for crease-resistant finishes
Spray rating and hydrostatic pressure test for water-repellent/waterproof fabrics

Program Name: Engineering Level: UG Branch: Textile Technology Subject Code: BE05029051 Subject Name: Quality Control in Chemical Processing Flammability testing (vertical flame test) for flame-proof fabrics
Basic performance evaluation of silicone softeners
anti-static, and soil- release finishes

units.title: Color Fastness Testing and Eco-Compliance
topics: Evaluation mechanisms and grading using Grey Scales for Change in Color and Staining : Color fastness to washing (Laundrometer)
rubbing/crockers (Crockmeter)
perspiration (Perspirations tester), and light (Xenon arc)
Color fastness to hot pressing and sublimation
Eco-Parameters: Overview of restricted substances in chemical processing (banned azo dyes
formaldehyde limits
heavy metals) and compliance basics (OEKO-TEX
ZDHC)
